lines.intro: Welcome to Rooftop Golf! Your word is your shot. Spell it and the ball flies.
lines.spell: Tap the letters to spell the word.
lines.tryAgain: Not yet. Read the clue again, then try once more.
lines.spelled: You spelled it! Now take your shot.
lines.courseDone: All ten holes are done. You won the Tower Cup!
lines.resume: Welcome back. Your game is right where you left it.
lines.fresh: Here is a new word to try.

phonicsHint.label: SOUND HINT
phonicsHint.line: Here is a hint about the sounds.

revealPattern.label: SHOW A PART
revealPattern.line: Here is part of the word.

showAnswer.label: SHOW ME
showAnswer.line: Here is the word. Spell it with the tiles.

misconceptions.spelling.shortVowel: Listen to the middle sound again. Which vowel do you hear?
misconceptions.spelling.silentE: Does the vowel say its name? A quiet e at the end can make it do that.
misconceptions.spelling.vowelTeam: Two vowels can team up to make one sound. Look at the vowels again.
misconceptions.spelling.blend: Say the word slowly. Some sounds go fast together. Did you hear them all?
misconceptions.spelling.digraph: Some sounds need two letters together. Look at that sound again.
misconceptions.spelling.doubleLetter: Look for a letter that comes two times. One or two?
misconceptions.spelling.silentLetter: Some words have a letter you cannot hear. Look for a quiet letter.
misconceptions.spelling.letterOrder: Those letters fit. Try them in a new order, sound by sound.
misconceptions.spelling.ending: Listen to the end of the word again. Which letters make that sound?

w01.meaning: The box of the elevator that people ride in.
w01.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short a, like in apple.

w02.blank: Turn the ___ to hold the bolt tight.
w02.meaning: A small metal piece with a hole. It twists onto a bolt.
w02.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short u, like in up.

w03.meaning: A thin metal stick that holds parts together.
w03.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short i, like in itch.

w04.meaning: Something with sides and a lid to keep things in.
w04.phonics: Three letters. The last letter makes two sounds, k and s.

w05.blank: The ___ rings when the doors open.
w05.meaning: It goes ding when the elevator gets to a floor.
w05.phonics: A short e in the middle. The end has the same letter two times.

w06.meaning: To pick something up and move it higher.
w06.phonics: A short i. It ends with f and t, said fast together.

w07.phonics: It starts with s and t, said fast together. Then a short o.

w08.meaning: The end of a cord that you push in to get power.
w08.phonics: It starts with p and l, said fast together. The vowel is a short u.

w09.meaning: A long loop that goes around and makes a machine turn.
w09.phonics: A short e. It ends with l and t, said fast together.

w10.meaning: A tool that squeezes things and holds them tight.
w10.phonics: It starts with c and l and ends with m and p. The vowel is a short a.

w11.blank: The cable wraps around a big ___.
w11.meaning: A round thing. You can bang one to make a beat.
w11.phonics: It starts with d and r, said fast together. The vowel is a short u.

w12.blank: The crates came on a big ___.
w12.meaning: A big boat that sails on the sea.
w12.phonics: It starts with two letters that make one sound, the sound for be quiet.

w13.blank: The elevator goes up and down the ___.
w13.meaning: The tall tunnel the elevator rides in.
w13.phonics: It starts with the sound for be quiet. It ends with f and t.

w14.meaning: To look at something to make sure it is okay.
w14.phonics: It starts with c and h together. It ends with c and k together.

w15.meaning: A little road to walk on.
w15.phonics: A short a. It ends with t and h together.

w16.blank: The ___ turns and pulls the cable.
w16.meaning: A round thing that rolls or spins.
w16.phonics: It starts with w and h together. Two e letters in the middle say their name.

w17.meaning: It keeps a door shut until you use the key.
w17.phonics: A short o. It ends with c and k together.

w18.meaning: The sound a bell makes. It is also a circle you wear on a finger.
w18.phonics: A short i. It ends with n and g together, like the end of sing.

w19.phonics: The a says its name. A quiet e at the end helps it.

w20.blank: Pull the ___ to raise the flag.
w20.meaning: Thick string made of strands twisted together.
w20.phonics: The o says its name. A quiet e at the end helps it.

w21.phonics: It starts with s and l. The i says its name, with a quiet e at the end.

w22.meaning: Water that falls from the clouds.
w22.phonics: The a says its name. Two vowels go walking, a and i.

w23.blank: The elevator can carry a big ___.
w23.meaning: All the things you carry at one time.
w23.phonics: The o says its name. Two vowels go walking, o and a.

w24.phonics: It starts with s and t. Two e letters together say their name.

w25.blank: A steel ___ holds up the roof.
w25.meaning: A long, strong bar that holds up a building.
w25.phonics: The e says its name. Two vowels go walking, e and a.

w26.blank: Press the button and the ___ comes on.
w26.meaning: It helps you see in the dark.
w26.phonics: The i says its name. The g and h after it make no sound.

w27.blank: Each ___ has teeth that turn the next one.
w27.meaning: A wheel with teeth that turns another wheel.
w27.phonics: It rhymes with ear and hear.

w28.meaning: A metal rod with a head. A nut twists onto it.
w28.phonics: The o says its name. It ends with l and t.

w29.meaning: A small thing you press to make something work.
w29.phonics: Two parts. The middle has two t letters.

w30.meaning: It flies up into space with fire under it.
w30.phonics: Two parts. The first part ends with c and k together.

w31.blank: A ___ sticks to the steel door.
w31.meaning: A piece of metal that pulls iron and steel to it.
w31.phonics: Two parts. Each part has a short vowel.

w32.blank: A strong ___ pulls the elevator up.
w32.meaning: A thick wire rope that pulls something.
w32.phonics: Two parts. The a says its name. It ends with b, l, e, like table.

w33.blank: The green light is a ___ to go.
w33.meaning: A light or sound that tells you what to do.
w33.phonics: Two parts. Listen for the g at the end of the first part.

w34.meaning: A machine that makes something move.
w34.phonics: Two parts. The first o says its name. It ends with o and r.

w35.blank: Use a ___ to turn the bolt.
w35.meaning: A tool that grips a bolt or nut and turns it.
w35.phonics: The w at the start makes no sound. It ends with n, c and h.

w36.blank: We ___ the stairs to the roof.
w36.meaning: To go up using your hands and feet.
w36.phonics: The i says its name. The b at the end makes no sound.

w37.blank: Turn the ___ to open the door.
w37.phonics: The k at the start makes no sound. Then a short o.

w39.blank: Blow the ___ to start the race.
w39.meaning: A small thing you blow into to make a high, loud sound.
w39.phonics: Two parts. It starts with w and h together. The t makes no sound.

w40.blank: Put a ___ on your head when it is sunny.
w40.meaning: A soft hat with a brim at the front.
w40.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short a, like in apple.

w41.blank: Turn on the ___ to cool the room.
w41.meaning: It spins and blows air on you.
w41.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short a, like in apple.

w42.blank: A big ___ flies over the rooftop.
w42.meaning: A fast plane with loud engines.
w42.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short e, like in egg.

w43.blank: The spider spins a ___ in the corner.
w43.meaning: Sticky threads a spider makes to catch bugs.
w43.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short e, like in egg.

w44.blank: The ___ is hot and bright at noon.
w44.meaning: The big star that lights up our day.
w44.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short u, like in up.

w45.blank: At night we sleep in a soft ___.
w45.meaning: Where you lie down to sleep.
w45.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short e, like in egg.

w46.blank: Put a ___ at the end of the line.
w46.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short o, like in octopus.

w47.blank: A frog sits on a ___ in the pond.
w47.meaning: A thick piece of a tree trunk.
w47.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short o, like in octopus.

w48.blank: A red ___ has a long bushy tail.
w48.meaning: A wild animal like a small dog, often red.
w48.phonics: Three sounds. It ends with the letter that sounds like ks.

w49.blank: A baby goat is called a ___.
w49.meaning: A young goat, or a child.
w49.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short i, like in itch.

w50.blank: The ___ brings boxes to the building.
w50.meaning: A big car with room for lots of things.
w50.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short a, like in apple.

w51.blank: Look at the ___ to find the way.
w51.meaning: A drawing that shows where places are.
w51.phonics: Three sounds. The middle sound is a short a, like in apple.

w52.blank: The ___ says meow and naps in the sun.
w52.phonics: It rhymes with rat. Listen for the first sound.

w53.blank: The ___ ran under the barn with its long tail.
w53.meaning: A small animal with a long thin tail that squeaks.
w53.phonics: It rhymes with mat. Listen for the first sound.

w54.blank: Wipe your feet on the ___ by the door.
w54.meaning: A flat rug you stand on.
w54.phonics: It rhymes with bat. Listen for the first sound.

w55.meaning: A wooden stick for hitting a ball.
w55.phonics: It rhymes with cat. Listen for the first sound.

w56.blank: The pink ___ rolls in the mud.
w56.meaning: A farm animal with a curly tail that oinks.
w56.phonics: It rhymes with wig. Listen for the first sound.

w57.blank: Use a spade to ___ a hole.
w57.meaning: To make a hole in the dirt.
w57.phonics: It rhymes with wig. Listen for the first sound.

w58.blank: The clown wears a funny ___ of red hair.
w58.meaning: Hair you can put on and take off.
w58.phonics: It rhymes with pig. Listen for the first sound.

w59.blank: An elephant is a very ___ animal.
w59.phonics: It rhymes with dig. Listen for the first sound.

w60.blank: Clean the wet floor with a ___.
w60.meaning: A stick with soft strings for washing floors.
w60.phonics: It rhymes with hop. Listen for the first sound.

w61.meaning: To jump on one foot, or jump like a bunny.
w61.phonics: It rhymes with mop. Listen for the first sound.

w62.blank: Hold the eggs and do not ___ them.
w62.phonics: It rhymes with mop. Listen for the first sounds.

w63.blank: The balloon will ___ if you poke it.
w63.phonics: It rhymes with hop. Listen for the first sound.

w64.blank: A little ___ crawls on the leaf.
w64.meaning: A tiny animal with six legs.
w64.phonics: It rhymes with mug. Listen for the first sound.

w65.meaning: Holding someone close with both arms.
w65.phonics: It rhymes with rug. Listen for the first sound.

w66.meaning: A big cup with a handle.
w66.phonics: It rhymes with bug. Listen for the first sound.

w67.blank: The dog naps on the soft ___.
w67.meaning: A small carpet on the floor.
w67.phonics: It rhymes with hug. Listen for the first sound.

w68.meaning: A woven thing with a handle for carrying.
w68.phonics: Two parts. The first part has a short a and the second has a short e.

w69.meaning: A place where plants and flowers grow.
w69.phonics: Two parts. The first part says gar, like a car with a g.

w70.meaning: A stick you write and draw with.
w70.phonics: Two parts. The first part says pen. The second part has a short i.

w71.blank: The ___ hops and wiggles its nose.
w71.meaning: A soft animal with long ears.
w71.phonics: Two parts. The middle has two letters that are the same.

w72.meaning: When the day ends and the light goes down.
w72.phonics: Two small words put together, one for the sky and one for down.

w73.blank: The ___ chases a ball of yarn.
w73.phonics: Two parts. The middle has two letters that are the same.

w74.meaning: A cloth or paper square used at meals.
w74.phonics: Two parts. The first part says nap.

w75.blank: We eat a ___ lunch on the grass.
w75.phonics: Two parts. Each part ends with the same sound as a k.
